verdict.rationale: Base44 documents GitHub-connected local development that keeps code written locally and code written in Base44 in sync. The CLI also syncs data models and code and deploys resources from the terminal, which covers pushing local changes back to the platform. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the round-trip sync, and documented detail on the push/sync workflow (conflict handling, frontend code push via CLI versus GitHub only).

support.subject: As a developer, I can work on the app locally with my own editor and tooling and push changes back to the platform

citations.quote: Connect your app to GitHub to write code in your local development environment or in Base44 and keep them in sync with each other.
Connect your Base44 app to GitHub for version control, local development, and collaboration.
Create new backend projects, sync data models and code, deploy resources, and run commands against any app on your account
